sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT r.remit_claim_id) FROM sem.remit_claims r JOIN sem.adjustments a ON a.remit_claim_id = r.remit_claim_id WHERE r.is_current_adjudication AND r.is_denied AND a.group_code = 'CO' AND a.carc_code = '16'
